name: Kitakyushu (Japan)
description: A violet field charged at the centre with the Kitakyushu city emblem in white: a five-petalled plum-blossom outline enclosing a five-pointed star shape.
history: Kitakyushu was created in February 1963 by the merger of five cities; the five-part emblem commemorates them.

features.role: Kitakyushu city emblem — a five-petalled blossom with inner star
features.symbolism: the five petals stand for Moji, Kokura, Tobata, Yahata and Wakamatsu, the five cities merged in 1963 to create Kitakyushu
